Tony420's first hijack is not in this list: it is Tony420Hijack (tony420_hotspot_hijack.json) and always wins the first hotspot. Airdrops (icq_airdrops.md) are NOT queued: they deposit a payload and wait on has_inspected_first_crypto_trash and the wallet. Hamstradamus (icq_hamstradamus = allowed, round v43, 2026-11-12) is an ICQ contact and an NPC-style cameo, never a companion, pet or equippable; his in-the-flesh appearances are future content.
